name: Prism
author: byo-pop
description: A game mode: ten kinds of gem on a 9 x 9 board, and runs count on the diagonals too. With so many colours a straight line is rarer, so look along the slants; diagonal runs score a bonus, and crossing runs join into an L, T or plus for more. Half of all moves set off a cascade. Uses its own high-score table.
